### Short answer
The passages do not define **“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope”** as a formal term; the supported meaning is a practical mapping from high-speed **Signal Integrity / SI** validation needs to oscilloscope-related measurement roles, where **scopes** are listed for **Interface Test** and **Power Distribution Network** testing in the SerDes/SI/PI validation context [1][3][10].  
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this mapping include whether an oscilloscope/scope is part of **Interface Test**, whether a scope is used for **PDN / Power Integrity** work, and how to separate oscilloscope-relevant SI observations such as **Eye diagram** from network-analyzer / TDR-style measurements such as **IL, Xtalk, TDR impedance, DK/DF, Delta-L, and high-speed trace / cable tests** [1][3][13][28][49][53][74].  
### Supported details
- In the high-speed electrical interface validation context, Slide 11 links **Interface Test** to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices** [1][3][10].  
- The same validation context links **Power Distribution Network** testing to **scopes and network analyzers** [1][3][10].  
- The SI flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA lists **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator** [1][3][10].  
- R&S PCB test solutions for PCB Fabricator and System House include measurement/process choices such as **Material Measurement**, **Material/Stackup selection**, **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**, **Sampling testing**, and **PL / Process Monitoring** [49][51][53].  
- Those R&S PCB test-solution stages list measurement items including **Impedance (TDR), DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, Eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, and cable / connector testing** [13][49][53].  
- In an AI server solution mapping, **R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB** are mapped to PCB **IL / TDR**, connector/line **high speed cable** testing, PCBA **high speed trace test**, and GPU **TDR** contexts [28][74].  
- In the same mapping, **MXO** is listed for **power rail, multiphase DC, PI, and motor driver analysis**, while **R&S ZNL** is listed for **PDN Target Z** [28][70].  
- The passages explicitly warn that the sources do **not** provide formal product configurations, option codes, fixtures, calibration methods, or complete measurement conditions for these SI/PI mappings [2][12][14][41][73].

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Reference plane 與 vias
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signal trace 從 origination 到 termination 必須全程維持相同 GND reference。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若無法維持相同 GND reference，需 via-stitch 兩個 GND planes，以確保 continuous grounding 與 uniform impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 stitching vias 應對稱放置於 signal transition vias 50 mils center-to-center 以內，越近越好。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signals 必須 route over solid reference plane，除非絕對必要，不應跨越 plane split 或 reference plane void。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 TI 不建議 high-speed signal references 使用 power planes。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若完全無法避免 routing over a plane-split，需在 split 兩側放置 stitching capacitors，提供 high-frequency current return path；stitching capacitors 必須為 1 µF 或更低，並盡可能靠近 plane crossing。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 vias 需要 staggered placement；aligned vias 會阻擋 current return path。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 high-speed traces 只放在 top layer 或 bottom layer；若需要 vias，應考慮 back drilling，否則 stub length 可能降低 signal bandwidth。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 via transitions 造成的 stubs 若長於 15 mils，應 back-drill 以降低 insertion losses 並避免 resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe Gen5 20/80% rise/fall time 為 12 ps；為保留 12 ps rise/fall time，需要約 29 GHz bandwidth（0.35/0.12 ns rule）。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說在 29 GHz bandwidth 且使用 Megtron 6（ε 約 3.4）時，quarter wavelength 約 54 mils；若未使用 back drilling，stub 必須小於約 54 mils；對 typical FR4（ε 約 4.2）PCB，maximum stub length 約 51 mils。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Routing quick rules
[[snla426]]（June 2023）列出的 high-speed differential signal quick rules 包括：

- 不可在任何 high-speed differential signal 上放置 probe 或 test points。
- 不可將 high-speed traces route 在 crystals、oscillators、clock signal generators、switching power regulators、mounting holes、magnetic devices、board edge，或使用 / 複製 clock signals 的 ICs 下方或附近。
- BGA breakout 後，high-speed differential signals 應避開 PCIe device，因為 internal state transitions 產生的 high current transients 很難濾除。
- 盡可能將 high-speed differential pair signals route 在 PCB top layer 或 bottom layer，並搭配 adjacent GND layer。
- High-speed differential signals 與 reference plane edge 的距離需 ≥ 5×W 或 5×RPH，取較大者。
- High-speed differential signals 至少需距離 reference plane voids 4×RPH；此規則不適用於 high-speed differential signals 上 SMD pads 的 voiding。
- PCIe device BGA escape 後需維持 constant trace width，以避免 transmission lines 中的 impedance mismatches。
- 為改善 crosstalk，應遵循 ground-signal-ground signal routing，並將所有 high-speed differential pairs 對稱且平行地一起 routing。
- Package escape 與 routing 到 connector pins 時會自然偏離此要求，但 trace deviations 必須盡可能短，否則可能需要 trace width compensation。
- HFSS simulation 可用於最佳化 trace width。
- 多個 high-speed interfaces 的 devices 中，需避免不同 interfaces 間的 crosstalk。
- Package escape 後、connector termination 前，每個 differential pair 不應 route 在另一 differential pair 的 4–5×RPH mils 內。

### Short answer
The passages do not define **“signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope”** as a formal term; the supported meaning is a practical mapping from high-speed **Signal Integrity / SI** validation needs to oscilloscope-related measurement roles, where **scopes** are listed for **Interface Test** and **Power Distribution Network** testing in the SerDes/SI/PI validation context [1][3][10].  
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this mapping include whether an oscilloscope/scope is part of **Interface Test**, whether a scope is used for **PDN / Power Integrity** work, and how to separate oscilloscope-relevant SI observations such as **Eye diagram** from network-analyzer / TDR-style measurements such as **IL, Xtalk, TDR impedance, DK/DF, Delta-L, and high-speed trace / cable tests** [1][3][13][28][49][53][74].

- In the high-speed electrical interface validation context, Slide 11 links **Interface Test** to **scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices** [1][3][10].  
- The same validation context links **Power Distribution Network** testing to **scopes and network analyzers** [1][3][10].  
- The SI flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA lists **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator** [1][3][10].  
- R&S PCB test solutions for PCB Fabricator and System House include measurement/process choices such as **Material Measurement**, **Material/Stackup selection**, **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**, **Sampling testing**, and **PL / Process Monitoring** [49][51][53].  
- Those R&S PCB test-solution stages list measurement items including **Impedance (TDR), DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, Eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, and cable / connector testing** [13][49][53].
